general.description: In the border of the Iraliaash System, just in orbit of the jump point linked to Drom, the Irali Core Guard Station watch over the entrance of the Rith cradle-world, making sure that none of the inter-tribal conflicts spreads all the ways in this sanctuarized place.
general.bar: Elite Rithguard claded with Core Guard blason, most of them natives from the nearly Irali capital-world.
